caption: The drawing depicts a figure standing on a gray oval base. The figure is dressed in a white top hat with a black band, a yellow vest with black buttons over a white long-sleeved shirt, a black necktie, red pants, and black shoes. The figure has a black face and hands and holds a long black staff or cane with a loop at the top in its left hand. The figure’s right hand is placed on its hip. The background is plain and beige. In the bottom right corner, the signature "Rex Bush" is written in red cursive script.
title: Cast Iron Dobbie
